moments.title: Premier League Kicks Off!
moments.blurb: The 2026/27 Premier League season officially starts today, Saturday August 22nd, with a packed schedule of opening weekend fixtures across the UK.

angles.name: General Excitement
angles.copy: It's back! The Premier League season 2026/27 kicks off today. Who are you backing for the title?

angles.name: Local Team Focus
angles.copy: Your team is back in action! Premier League is LIVE today – catch all the opening weekend drama.

angles.name: Weekend Plans
angles.copy: Football fans, your weekend plans are sorted! The new Premier League season is officially underway.

moments.title: All Points East Festival Continues
moments.blurb: London's All Points East festival is in full swing this weekend, with Lorde headlining tonight (Saturday 22nd) and Deftones on Sunday 23rd, before returning next weekend with Tyler, The Creator and Twenty One Pilots.

angles.name: Saturday Headliner
angles.copy: Lorde takes the stage tonight at All Points East! Who's at Victoria Park for the atmospheric pop queen?

angles.name: Weekend Vibes
angles.copy: All Points East is delivering the goods this weekend! Deftones tomorrow, Lorde tonight - London is rocking.

angles.name: Next Weekend Tease
angles.copy: Still buzzing from All Points East? Tyler, The Creator and Twenty One Pilots are still to come next weekend!

moments.title: We Out Here Festival Wraps Up
moments.blurb: The Gilles Peterson-curated We Out Here Festival in Dorset concludes today, Saturday August 22nd, after four days celebrating jazz, soul, hip hop, and UK club culture.

angles.name: Last Day Energy
angles.copy: It's the final day of We Out Here Festival in Dorset! Who's soaking up the last of the incredible jazz, soul, and club sounds?

angles.name: Festival Recap
angles.copy: What a weekend at We Out Here! Gilles Peterson's festival wraps up today, leaving us with some amazing musical memories.

moments.title: Wilco Live in Glasgow
moments.blurb: American alt-rock pioneers Wilco bring their iconic sound to the Glasgow Royal Concert Hall tonight, Saturday August 22nd, celebrating 30 years in independent music.

angles.name: Tonight's Gig
angles.copy: Glasgow! Wilco are in town tonight at the Royal Concert Hall. Ready for a night of their pioneering alt-rock?

angles.name: 30 Years of Wilco
angles.copy: Celebrating 30 years of Wilco's incredible music tonight in Glasgow! What's your favourite Wilco track?

moments.title: Happy 78th to David Marks
moments.blurb: David Marks, guitarist and early member of The Beach Boys, celebrates his 78th birthday today, Saturday August 22nd.

angles.name: Beach Boys Legend
angles.copy: Happy 78th Birthday to David Marks, an original Beach Boy! Still surfing through the years.

angles.name: Guitar Hero
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 78th to David Marks, the talented guitarist who helped shape The Beach Boys' early sound!

moments.title: Happy 65th to Roland Orzabal
moments.blurb: Roland Orzabal, co-founder, singer, and songwriter of the iconic duo Tears For Fears, turns 65 today, Saturday August 22nd.

angles.name: 80s Icon
angles.copy: Happy 65th Birthday to Roland Orzabal of Tears For Fears! What's your go-to track from the synth-pop legends?

angles.name: Mad World
angles.copy: Shout out to Roland Orzabal, 65 today! Still ruling the world with those incredible Tears For Fears hits.

moments.title: Happy 63rd to Tori Amos
moments.blurb: The influential singer-songwriter and pianist Tori Amos celebrates her 63rd birthday today, Saturday August 22nd.

angles.name: Alternative Legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 63rd Birthday to the unique and brilliant Tori Amos! What's your favourite album from her incredible discography?

angles.name: Piano Powerhouse
angles.copy: Happy Birthday to the one and only Tori Amos, 63 today! A true pioneer in music.

moments.title: Happy 31st to Dua Lipa
moments.blurb: Global pop superstar Dua Lipa celebrates her 31st birthday today, Saturday August 22nd.

angles.name: Pop Queen
angles.copy: Happy 31st Birthday to the incredible Dua Lipa! Get ready to dance the night away to her hits.

angles.name: Future Nostalgia
angles.copy: Dua Lipa turns 31 today! What's your favourite track from the queen of pop?

moments.title: Creamfields Returns Next Weekend
moments.blurb: The UK's biggest dance festival, Creamfields, takes over Daresbury, Cheshire from Thursday August 27th to Sunday August 30th, featuring headline sets from Swedish House Mafia, Calvin Harris, Disclosure and more.

angles.name: Festival Countdown
angles.copy: 5 days to go until Creamfields 2026! Who's heading to Daresbury for the ultimate dance music experience?

angles.name: Lineup Hype
angles.copy: Ready for Swedish House Mafia, Calvin Harris, Disclosure and more? Creamfields is almost here!

moments.title: Reading & Leeds Festivals Next Week
moments.blurb: Reading & Leeds Festivals are set to rock Richfield Avenue and Bramham Park from Friday August 28th to Sunday August 30th, bringing a huge lineup of rock, indie, and alternative acts.

angles.name: Festival Excitement
angles.copy: Who's ready for Reading & Leeds next weekend?! The countdown is on for one of the biggest festivals of the summer.

angles.name: Headliner Tease
angles.copy: Reading or Leeds? Whatever your choice, get ready for an epic weekend of music from Friday!

moments.title: Big City Festival in Glasgow
moments.blurb: Glasgow's Big City Festival returns to Queen's Park on Saturday August 29th, featuring Super Furry Animals, Spiritualized and more.

angles.name: Scottish Festival
angles.copy: Big City Festival is coming to Glasgow next Saturday! Super Furry Animals and Spiritualized in Queen's Park – who's in?

angles.name: Indie Legends
angles.copy: Super Furry Animals and Spiritualized in Glasgow next weekend! Get ready for some indie classics at Big City Festival.

moments.title: McFly Live in Glasgow
moments.blurb: Pop-rock legends McFly are set to play Glasgow's Queen's Park on Thursday August 27th as part of Summer Nights on the Southside 2026.

angles.name: McFly Mania
angles.copy: McFly are heading to Glasgow next Thursday! Who's ready to sing along to all their hits at Queen's Park?

angles.name: Summer Nights
angles.copy: Catch McFly live in Glasgow next week! A perfect summer night out with the pop-rock legends.

moments.title: Happy 75th to Rob Halford

angles.name: Metal God
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the Metal God himself, Rob Halford of Judas Priest! What's your favourite Priest anthem?

angles.name: Legendary Voice
angles.copy: Wishing a thunderous 75th to Rob Halford! His voice defined generations of heavy metal.

moments.title: Happy 72nd to Elvis Costello
moments.blurb: Influential rock singer-songwriter Elvis Costello turns 72 on Tuesday August 25th.

angles.name: Musical Maverick
angles.copy: Happy 72nd Birthday to the brilliant Elvis Costello! From 'Pump It Up' to 'She', his catalogue is timeless.

angles.name: Still Amazing
angles.copy: 72 today! Happy Birthday to Elvis Costello, a true legend of rock and new wave.

moments.title: Happy 77th to Gene Simmons
moments.blurb: Gene Simmons, the iconic 'Demon' bassist and co-founder of rock legends KISS, celebrates his 77th birthday on Tuesday August 25th.

angles.name: Rock Icon
angles.copy: Happy 77th Birthday to the one and only Gene Simmons! Still rocking and rolling all nite.

angles.name: KISS Legend
angles.copy: Shout out to Gene Simmons, 77 today! The 'Demon' of KISS still commands the stage.

moments.title: August Bank Holiday Weekend
moments.blurb: The UK's August Bank Holiday weekend (England, Wales, and Northern Ireland) falls on Monday August 31st, marking the unofficial end of summer.

angles.name: Long Weekend Prep
angles.copy: Get ready for the last long weekend of summer! The August Bank Holiday is just around the corner, Monday 31st!

angles.name: End of Summer Plans
angles.copy: August Bank Holiday weekend is next week! How are you planning to make the most of the unofficial end of summer?

moments.title: Happy 56th to Debbie Gibson
moments.blurb: 80s pop sensation Debbie Gibson, known for hits like 'Foolish Beat' and 'Lost In Your Eyes', celebrates her 56th birthday on Monday August 31st.

angles.name: 80s Pop Princess
angles.copy: Happy 56th Birthday to the original pop princess, Debbie Gibson! Still shining bright since 'Out of the Blue'.

angles.name: Teen Idol
angles.copy: Remember 'Foolish Beat'? Happy 56th to the incredible Debbie Gibson, a true teen idol of the 80s!
